title: [UE-0.18] Guardrail rehearsal
body:
### MVP item (number from docs/jam-brief.md), Day 0, or Stretch: <name>

Day 0

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### GDD revision (the one in docs/gdd/CURRENT, e.g. 1.3)

1.3

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Player outcome (the player sees X, does Y, can tell why; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Owner role

Agent Ops

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

QA and Build

### Human who runs and merges this

Josh

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `scratch/**` on a branch `ue-0.18-rehearsal` that is never merged, `pipeline/agent-ops/` ([VERIFY] tags only)

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `scratch/**` on a branch `ue-0.18-rehearsal` that is never merged, `pipeline/agent-ops/` ([VERIFY] tags only)
Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**
Locks: none

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.17, UE-0.3

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

none (no later card lists it in After)

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] One fake card, run by the Agent Ops agent in a sandboxed session, hits every block and ask in `pipeline/agent-ops/README.md` (pastes on the card; an ask nobody answers counts as refused)
- [ ] `prompt_log.py attempts --card 0.18` exits 1 after two planted build failures (pasted)
- [ ] A sandboxed role session posts one `gh issue comment` on this card, so the `~/.config/gh` read deny does not block `gh` (pasted)
- [ ] Each `VERIFY on 0.18` tag is removed in the card's gate patch with its paste
- [ ] Kickoff applies it itself through the tool checks (`python3 tools/git_gate.py apply UE-0.18 --auto`: every path in the card's lane, no guardrail enforcer changed, no guardrail file loosened; the PR has a `GATE EDIT: by=kickoff` line naming the patched paths); `grep -rI "VERIFY on 0.18" pipeline/agent-ops` prints 0 lines (exit 1)
- [ ] Done by the Clock's card 0.9 cutoff

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
